title: A Binary Normal Form and an Audited Proof Attempt for the Two-Player 3n+/-1 Game
description: We study the two-player 3n+/-1 problem stated at https://althofer.de/collatz-prizes.html. The repository develops an exact binary normal form, constant-tail and source identities, finite WIN/LOSS proof heights, and a conditional symbolic routing certificate. An external audit by Ingo Althöfer identified a genuine gap in the old global entry argument. Corrected Sections 136--138 withdraw the invalid coefficient-source inference and prove a universal two-level arithmetic normalization for the previously omitted factorful exponent-one family. The remaining arbitrary exponent-one provenance/rank attachment lemma is explicitly OPEN, so this audited repair does not claim that the global no-DRAW theorem has been proved.
notes: The published DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21844684 predates the external audit and contains the earlier proof claim. Do not create a new proof release from this repair branch while the arbitrary exponent-one attachment lemma remains open. Correspondence: n_854@mail.ru.
